name: original-57-news-benchmark-v1
verified_news2019_gain_sensitivity: 0 for grade 0, else 2^grade; include after independent full-pair provenance audit
unjudged_policy: zero gain/relevance contribution without removing unjudged ranks; report judged coverage
missing_document_policy: retain all original judgments in primary IDCG and AP denominators
sensitivity: evaluate the same rankings against qrels restricted to shared eligible documents
zero_relevant_policy: score zero and retain the query in macro averages
ranking_order: published rank order; derived strictly descending rank scores for trec_eval cross-check
self_document_policy: no inferred exclusions based only on matching article titles; same retrieval corpus for both engines
crosscheck: independent trec_eval bundled with Anserini; four-decimal output tolerance 0.000051
status: protocol recorded before computing comparison metrics; parameters are not tuned on these judgments
